"""Resume the same finite Git-only publisher after verified immutable reconciliation."""
import json,os,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
run='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v33';folder=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-20261025';state_path=folder/('publisher-'+run+'.json');state=read_json(state_path)
assert state['status']=='checkpoint_pushed_and_raw_bytes_verified' and state['machine_id']==machine_id() and state['last_checkpoint_requests']==16
proof_path=ROOT/state['reconciliation'];assert file_sha256(proof_path)==state['reconciliation_sha256']
proof=read_json(proof_path);assert proof['checkpoint_requests']==16 and proof['actual_verified_readback']['status']=='verified'
assert state['last_commit']==proof['fixed_commit']==state['checkpoints'][0]['commit']
for path in folder.glob('publisher-resume-*.json'):
 if path!=state_path:assert read_json(path)['status']=='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline'
deadline=datetime.fromisoformat(state['original_deadline_utc']);assert datetime.now(timezone.utc)<deadline
production=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json');assert production['created_at_utc']==state['production_created_at_utc']
assert production['status'] in {'running','stopped_at_safe_boundary'}
if production['status']=='running':assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')=={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id()}
lock=folder/'publisher.lock';fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY);os.write(fd,str(os.getpid()).encode('ascii'));os.close(fd)
state.setdefault('same_run_continuations',[]).append({'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'old_pid':state['pid'],'new_pid':os.getpid(),'start_last_checkpoint_requests':16,'original_deadline_utc_unchanged':state['original_deadline_utc'],'reconciliation':state['reconciliation'],'source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'incremental_verifier_source':(ROOT/'runtime/verify-low-incremental-pinned-originals-20261026.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'frozen_publisher_source':(ROOT/'runtime/publish-low-with-incremental-readback-20261026.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')});state['pid']=os.getpid()
def persist(**kw):state.update(kw,observed_at_utc=utc_now());write_json(state_path,state)
def checked(args,timeout=3600):
 r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=timeout)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr)
 return r.stdout
try:
 last=state['last_checkpoint_requests'];persist(status='waiting_for_next_16_completed_requests')
 while datetime.now(timezone.utc)<deadline:
  owner_path=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json';live=owner_path.exists() and read_json(owner_path).get('run_id')==run
  production=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json');calls=production['completed_source_requests'];running=live and production['status']=='running'
  if calls-last<16 and running:
   persist(status='waiting_for_next_16_completed_requests',last_completed_requests=calls,last_checkpoint_requests=last);time.sleep(20);continue
  if last==calls and not running:break
  if (ROOT/'runtime/master-git-readback.lock').exists():
   persist(status='waiting_for_existing_original_readback',last_completed_requests=calls);time.sleep(20);continue
  seq=len(state['checkpoints'])+1;batch='resumed-low-v33-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
  while (ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints'/batch).exists():seq+=1;batch='resumed-low-v33-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
  persist(status='snapshotting_LOW_scope',last_completed_requests=calls)
  checked([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoint-20261025.py'),batch,'--incremental'])
  receipt=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints/{batch}/receipt.json');publication=ROOT/f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json';assert not publication.exists()
  write_json(publication,{**receipt,'isolated_git_synchronization':{'status':'pending_in_separate_network_publisher','primary_worktree_untouched':True}})
  state['checkpoints'].append({'batch':batch,'commit':receipt['commit'],'completed_requests_at_snapshot':calls,'new_original_PNGs':receipt['new_original_PNGs']});persist(status='publishing_and_verifying_immutable_snapshot')
  checked([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'runtime/publish-low-with-incremental-readback-20261026.py'),receipt['commit'],batch])
  assert read_json(publication)['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified'
  last=calls;persist(status='checkpoint_pushed_and_raw_bytes_verified',last_checkpoint_requests=last,last_commit=receipt['commit'])
  if not running:break
 persist(status='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline',finished_at_utc=utc_now())
except BaseException:
 persist(status='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay',error=traceback.format_exc());raise
finally:

"""Reuse immutable prior local byte proofs; still verify remote tree and new raw bytes."""
import sys,os,json,hashlib,subprocess,traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from mod_nailong.tools import master_git_remote as remote
base='c31746182dc8107663580331813869b48b638666';commit,batch=sys.argv[1:3]
commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',commit+'^{commit}'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
prior=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/high131-local-tree-proofs/{base}.json');assert prior['status']=='verified' and prior['machine_id']==machine_id() and prior['commit']==base
old_index=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':mod_nailong/data/fullsize-files.json'],cwd=ROOT))
assert set(prior['blobs'])==set(old_index['outputs'])
def verified_tree(actual_commit='HEAD',root=ROOT,index=None):
 assert actual_commit==commit and index is not None
 assert all(index['outputs'].get(k)==v for k,v in old_index['outputs'].items()),'Prior indexed originals changed'
 rows=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','-l',commit,'--','mod_nailong/assets/generated_fullsize'],cwd=ROOT).decode().splitlines()
 tree={}
 for row in rows:
  meta,path=row.split('\t',1);mode,kind,blob,size=meta.split();tree[path]=(kind,blob,int(size))
 blobs={};pending=[]
 for digest,entry in sorted(index['outputs'].items()):
  kind,blob,size=tree[entry['path']];assert kind=='blob' and size==entry['bytes']
  if digest in prior['blobs']:
   assert blob==prior['blobs'][digest];blobs[digest]=blob
  else:pending.append((digest,entry,blob))
 process=subprocess.Popen(['git','cat-file','--batch'],cwd=ROOT,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
 try:
  for digest,entry,expected in pending:
   process.stdin.write((commit+':'+entry['path']+'\n').encode());process.stdin.flush();head=process.stdout.readline().decode().split();assert head==[expected,'blob',str(entry['bytes'])]
   sha=hashlib.sha256();left=entry['bytes']
   while left:
    block=process.stdout.read(min(left,1048576));assert block;sha.update(block);left-=len(block)
   assert process.stdout.read(1)==b'\n' and sha.hexdigest()==digest;blobs[digest]=expected
 finally:process.stdin.close();process.stdout.close();assert process.wait()==0
 assert len(blobs)==index['count']
 receipt['local_tree_validation']={'method':'Prior actual SHA256/size proof reused only after exact immutable blob/path/size match; every new Git PNG streamed and SHA256/size verified','prior_commit':base,'prior_local_proof_sha256':file_sha256(ROOT/f'runtime/high131-local-tree-proofs/{base}.json'),'prior_actual_verified_at_utc':prior['verified_at_utc'],'reused_local_byte_proofs':len(blobs)-len(pending),'new_streamed_Git_PNGs':len(pending),'new_streamed_Git_bytes':sum(e['bytes'] for _,e,_ in pending),'source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
 return commit,blobs
remote.verify_tree=verified_tree
receipt={'machine_id':machine_id(),'commit':commit,'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'process_id':os.getpid(),'status':'running'};out=ROOT/f'runtime/master-readback-{batch}.json';write_json(out,receipt)
lock=ROOT/'runtime/master-git-readback.lock';fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY);os.write(fd,str(os.getpid()).encode());os.close(fd)
try:
 result=remote.verify_remote(commit);receipt.update(status='verified',distinct_outputs=result['distinct_outputs'],original_png_bytes=result['original_png_bytes'],completed_at_utc=utc_now())
except BaseException:receipt.update(status='failed',error=traceback.format_exc(),completed_at_utc=utc_now());raise
finally:
 write_json(out,receipt);assert lock.read_text()==str(os.getpid());lock.unlink()

"""One bounded Git-only recovery; all primary workfiles remain untouched."""
import json, os, struct, subprocess, sys, traceback
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT, read_json, write_json, file_sha256, machine_id, utc_now
from mod_nailong.tools.master_files import sync_git

old = '4ae08918801f8b360da1ba48d97997486092c7e3'
batch = 'resumed-low-v33-auto-2-20261025'
run = 'resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v33'
ip = 'mod_nailong/data/fullsize-files.json'
work = ROOT / 'runtime/production-sync/v33-tail-index-recovery-20261028'
snap = ROOT / 'runtime/v33-tail-index-generated-20261028'
audit = ROOT / 'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261028-v33-tail-fullsize-index-rebase.json'
pubpath = ROOT / f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json'
sp = ROOT / f'runtime/resume-low-20261025/publisher-{run}.json'
before, state = read_json(pubpath), read_json(sp)
assert before['commit'] == old and before['status'] == 'push_pending_inspection_required'
assert 'CONFLICT (content)' in before['error']
assert state['status'] == 'stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay'
assert not audit.exists() and not work.exists() and not snap.exists()
deadline = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=3600)
record = {'machine_id': machine_id(), 'started_at_utc': utc_now(), 'status': 'prepared',
          'new_finite_git_only_deadline_utc': deadline.isoformat(),
          'original_publisher_deadline_utc_unchanged': state['original_deadline_utc'],
          'previous_exact_receipt': before, 'previous_exact_publisher_state': state,
          'scope': 'Fresh fetch and isolated rebase of the same unpublished LOW snapshot after remote advance. Rebuild only new fullsize entries with the existing generator; preserve all task and remote Git blobs. Ordinary FF push and pinned raw-byte verification. No image call, old deadline reset, force push, live working-file write, unrelated staging or public history rewrite.',
          'source_code': Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
write_json(audit, record)

def git(*args, cwd=ROOT, env=None, checked=True, timeout=240):
    p = subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'gc.auto=0', '-c', 'maintenance.auto=false', *args], cwd=cwd,
                       env={**os.environ, 'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0', **(env or {})}, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
    if checked:
        assert p.returncode == 0, (args, p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'), p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
        return p.stdout
    return p

def tree_entries(ref):
    result = {}
    for item in git('ls-tree', '-r', '-z', ref).split(b'\0'):
        if item:
            meta, path = item.split(b'\t', 1)
            result[path.decode('utf-8')] = tuple(meta.decode('ascii').split())
    return result

def index_entries(data):
    magic, version, count = struct.unpack('>4sII', data[:12])
    assert magic == b'DIRC' and version == 2
    pos, result = 12, {}
    for _ in range(count):
        start = pos
        flags = struct.unpack('>H', data[pos+60:pos+62])[0]
        assert not flags & 0x4000
        end = data.index(b'\0', pos+62)
        result[data[pos+62:end].decode()] = (data[pos:pos+40], data[pos+40:pos+60], flags & 0x3000)
        pos = start + ((end-start+1+7)//8)*8
    return result

lock = ROOT / 'runtime/production-publish.lock'
fd = os.open(lock, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({'process_id':os.getpid(), 'batch':batch+'-advanced-remote', 'machine_id':machine_id()}, f)
try:
    assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip() == old and not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
    assert git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip() == 'master'
    assert git('remote','get-url','origin').decode().strip().lower() == 'https://github.com/xenoamess/xenoamess_hoi4_dev.git'
    git('fetch','origin','master')
    remote = git('rev-parse','origin/master').decode().strip()
    base = git('rev-parse',old+'^').decode().strip()
    git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',base,remote)
    bi, ri, ti = [json.loads(git('show', ref+':'+ip)) for ref in [base,remote,old]]
    assert all(ri['outputs'].get(k) == ti['outputs'].get(k) == v for k,v in bi['outputs'].items())
    assert all(ri['outputs'][k] == ti['outputs'][k] for k in ri['outputs'].keys() & ti['outputs'].keys())
    union = {**ri['outputs'], **ti['outputs']}
    newkeys = set(union) - set(bi['outputs'])
    task_paths = set(git('diff','--name-only',base,old).decode().splitlines())
    record.update(remote_base=remote, common_base=base, new_union_entries=len(newkeys), union_count=len(union), task_paths=sorted(task_paths), status='isolated_rebase_started')
    write_json(audit, record)
    git('worktree','add','--detach','--no-checkout',str(work),old)
    git('sparse-checkout','set','--no-cone','--no-sparse-index','/AGENTS.md','/README.md','/.gitignore',cwd=work)
    git('read-tree','-mu','HEAD',cwd=work)
    result = git('rebase',remote,cwd=work,checked=False)
    assert result.returncode != 0, 'Unexpected clean rebase needs independent inspection.'
    assert git('diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=U',cwd=work).decode().splitlines() == [ip]
    generated = git('show',':0:mod_nailong/data/generated.json',cwd=work)
    (snap/'mod_nailong/data').mkdir(parents=True)
    (snap/'mod_nailong/data/generated.json').write_bytes(generated)
    masters = []
    for k in sorted(newkeys):
        e = union[k]
        source = ROOT / e['path']
        assert source.is_file(), source
        masters.append({**e, 'sha256':k, 'path':str(source)})
    rebuilt = sync_git({'current_masters_missing':[], 'historical_fullsize_sha_missing':[], 'masters':masters}, root=snap)
    assert rebuilt['outputs'] == {k:union[k] for k in sorted(newkeys)}
    assert (snap/'mod_nailong/data/generated.json').read_bytes() == generated
    rebuilt['outputs'] = dict(sorted({**bi['outputs'], **rebuilt['outputs']}.items()))
    rebuilt['count'] = len(rebuilt['outputs'])
    rebuilt['original_png_bytes'] = sum(e['bytes'] for e in rebuilt['outputs'].values())
    assert rebuilt['outputs'] == union
    write_json(snap/ip, rebuilt)
    (work/ip).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (work/ip).write_bytes((snap/ip).read_bytes())
    git('add','--sparse','--',ip,cwd=work)
    assert not git('diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=U',cwd=work).strip()
    tree = git('write-tree',cwd=work).decode().strip()
    t, o, r = map(tree_entries,[tree,old,remote])
    assert {p for p in t.keys()|r.keys() if t.get(p)!=r.get(p)} == task_paths
    assert all(t[p]==o[p] for p in task_paths-{ip})
    assert all(t[p]==v for p,v in r.items() if p not in task_paths)
    assert all(e['path'] in t and t[e['path']][1]=='blob' for e in union.values())
    git('-c','core.editor=true','rebase','--continue',cwd=work)
    new = git('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=work).decode().strip()
    assert git('rev-parse',new+'^').decode().strip()==remote
    git('diff','--check',remote,new)
    record.update(status='rebased_union_and_all_blobs_validated', new_private_commit=new, generated_index_sha256=file_sha256(snap/ip))
    write_json(audit,record)
    assert datetime.now(timezone.utc) < deadline
    git('-c','http.version=HTTP/1.1','push','origin',new+':refs/heads/master',timeout=900)
    observed = git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/master').decode().split()[0]
    if observed != new:
        git('fetch','origin','master')
        git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',new,observed)
    record.update(status='pushed_before_primary_metadata_adoption', remote_master_observed=observed)
    write_json(audit,record)
    gitdir = Path(git('rev-parse','--absolute-git-dir').decode().strip())
    index, ilock = gitdir/'index', gitdir/'index.lock'
    assert not ilock.exists()
    original = index.read_bytes()
    (snap/'original-primary.index').write_bytes(original)
    alt = snap/'stat-preserved.index'
    alt.write_bytes(original)
    env = {'GIT_INDEX_FILE':str(alt)}
    git('read-tree','-i','-m',old,new,env=env)
    assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only',new,env=env).strip()
    a, b = index_entries(original), index_entries(alt.read_bytes())
    same = [p for p in a.keys() & b.keys() if a[p][1:] == b[p][1:]]
    assert len(same)>28000 and all(a[p][0]==b[p][0] for p in same)
    fd = os.open(ilock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY)
    assert index.read_bytes()==original and git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==old
    with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:
        f.write(alt.read_bytes()); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
    git('update-ref','-m','Adopt validated isolated LOW rebase','refs/heads/master',new,old)
    os.replace(ilock,index)
    assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
    record.update(status='pushed_primary_metadata_adopted_readback_pending', preserved_stat_entries=len(same), working_file_writes=0)
    write_json(audit,record)
    before.setdefault('prior_private_commit_history',[]).append(old)
    before.update(commit=new,status='committed_and_pushed',pushed_at_utc=utc_now(),remote_master_observed=observed,
                  original_index_count=rebuilt['count'],advanced_remote_revalidation=audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
                  isolated_git_synchronization={'status':'validated_commit_rebased_unchanged_fast_forward_eligible','synchronized_commit':new,'origin_master':remote,'isolated_worktree':str(work)})
    write_json(pubpath,before)
except BaseException:
    record.update(status='requires_explicit_inspection_no_replay',error=traceback.format_exc(),failed_at_utc=utc_now())
    write_json(audit,record)
    raise
finally:
    assert read_json(lock)['process_id']==os.getpid()
    lock.unlink()
